title: Tesla's China-made EV sales rise 8.7% in March
title_zh: 特斯拉3月份中国产电动汽车销量增长8.7%
summary: BEIJING, April 2 (Reuters) - Sales of Tesla's China-made electric vehicle grew 8.7% from a year earlier to 85,670 vehicles in March, extending gains for a fifth month, as the U.S. automaker navigated
summary_zh: 路透北京4月2日电 - 特斯拉3月份中国产电动汽车销量同比增长8.7%至85,670辆，连续第五个月延续增长势头，这家美国汽车制造商的发展势头强劲。

title: Satellite Operator Globalstar Rallies on Report That Amazon Is in Buyout Talks
title_zh: 卫星运营商 Globalstar 因亚马逊正在进行收购谈判的报道而上涨
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Globalstar Inc. shares rose in pre-market trading after a Financial Times report that Amazon.com Inc. is in talks to acquire the satellite provider.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——英国《金融时报》报道亚马逊公司正在就收购卫星提供商进行谈判后，Globalstar Inc. 股价在盘前交易中上涨。

title: FTSE 100 LIVE: Stocks fall after Trump threatens to hit Iran ‘extremely hard’
title_zh: 富时 100 实时指数：特朗普威胁“极其严厉”打击伊朗后股市下跌
summary: FTSE 100 fell on Thursday morning, after US president Donald Trump threatened to ramp up Iran attacks
summary_zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普威胁要加大对伊朗的袭击力度，富时 100 指数周四上午下跌

title: China says it supports law-abiding transnational deals after reports of Meta deal review
title_zh: 在Meta交易审查报告发布后，中国表示支持守法的跨国交易
summary: BEIJING, April 2 () - The Chinese government supports ‌companies with transnational ‌operations and technology cooperation ​deals according to needs and the law, commerce ministry spokesperson He ‌Yadong said ⁠on Thursday.
summary_zh: 北京，4 月 2 日 - 商务部发言人何亚东周四表示，中国政府根据需要和法律支持企业开展跨国经营和技术合作。

title: S&P 500’s War Pattern: The Wipeout Begins Every Thursday
title_zh: 标准普尔 500 指数的战争模式：每周四都会出现惨败
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Five weeks into a Middle East war that’s sending shockwaves through the global economy, the US stock market has settled into a predictable pattern.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——中东战争给全球经济带来冲击，五周后，美国股市已经进入了可预测的模式。

title: Stock market today: Dow S&P 500, Nasdaq futures stumble after Trump says war with Iran not yet over
title_zh: 今日股市：特朗普表示与伊朗的战争尚未结束，道指标普 500 指数和纳斯达克期货下跌
summary: A national address from the president failed to calm markets as the Iran war dominates fiscal conversation.
summary_zh: 由于伊朗战争主导了财政对话，总统的全国讲话未能安抚市场。

title: Amazon eyes $9 billion Globalstar deal to rival SpaceX's Starlink, FT reports
title_zh: 据英国《金融时报》报道，亚马逊计划以 90 亿美元收购 Globalstar，以与 SpaceX 的 Starlink 竞争
summary: Amazon is in talks to buy satellite telecom group Globalstar as it ramps up efforts to build its own ‌low-earth-orbit satellite business to rival SpaceX's Starlink, the Financial Times reported ‌on Wednesday, citing people familiar with the matter.
summary_zh: 据英国《金融时报》周三援引知情人士的话报道，亚马逊正在就收购卫星电信集团 Globalstar 进行谈判，该公司正在加大力度建立自己的低地球轨道卫星业务，以与 SpaceX 的 Starlink 竞争。

title: Apple's next chapter: Who succeeds Tim Cook?
title_zh: 苹果的下一章：谁接替蒂姆·库克？
summary: Asking for a Trend host Josh Lipton speaks with D.A. Davidson Head of Technology Research Gil Luria and Cleo Capital Managing Director Sarah Kunst about Apple CEO Tim Cook's handling of the company's legacy and his potential succession (AAPL).
summary_zh: 寻求潮流主持人乔什·利普顿 (Josh Lipton) 接受 D.A.

title: Could Apple's next 50 years of success lie in AI, foldable phones?
title_zh: 苹果下一个 50 年的成功能否依靠人工智能和可折叠手机？
summary: Apple (AAPL) is celebrating its 50th anniversary on Wednesday, April 1.
summary_zh: 苹果 (AAPL) 将于 4 月 1 日星期三庆祝成立 50 周年。
